snippet.title: Top-down tank shooting game "100%HITS" has released the Steam store page
snippet.description: 100% HITS is a mini tank tactical shooting game. It fights with powerful AI enemies. Time and ammo box are variables you need to consider. You can sneak attack the enemy behind the bunker or disturb the enemy by moving quickly. Anyway, you should always keep your head cool!
